name: Load-Balanced Cell Assignment
definition: Merging ray-segments for individual pixels are independent atomic tasks. A 2D coarse mesh is imposed on the 2D image screen. Elements are mesh-cells. Merging ray-segments for pixels in a mesh-cell is an atomic task performed by a single processor. The problem reduces to assigning mesh-cells to processors.
summary: Load-Balanced Cell Assignment distributes ray-segment merging workloads by assigning coarse 2D mesh-cells to processors based on global ray-segment counts to balance computational load.
